subject: Render DELTA3 plan: leaks/lifetime/shadow sync; options blocked on textures contract
body:
Read audit 007, current board, UNFREEZE and base 0aaffe3. Render plan for DELTA 3 (production edits allowed; no native build):
1. expandIndex leak: release expandIndex/expandSource/expandOut in tegu_render_generic_snapshot_rt fail path, matching command dealloc ownership.
2. Variant lifetime: stop freeing/count-resetting pipeline variants from tegu_render_generic_set_modules. Variants are immutable code and may be referenced by queued jobs; keep old-generation entries until pipeline dealloc, fixed 32-slot array, selection keyed by module bytes so old entries never match new modules. Add an explicit capacity refusal for new variants. Dealloc remains the only free point (job retains pipeline).
3. Shadow sync: tegu_shadow_sync_jobs will scan Dispatch.v2Textures as well as compositorTextures/renderTexture. Refresh all v2 shadow textures before jobs; write back only v2 textures whose Metal usage includes ShaderWrite (bit1), not read-only samples. Compute: if you expose an exact per-descriptor access/write mask, I will replace the usage filter; otherwise this is conservative and avoids clobbering read-only surfaces.
4. Options/first_vertex/varyings: blocked until textures posts the n2r first_provoking_vertex + FAU draw-parameter contract. I will not wire tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_options or remove the vertexStart refusal on assumptions; exact contract and host fixture required.
Host tests: extend the render host harness for fail-path retain counts if feasible, variant-generation selection, and compile/syntax. No phone/publish/commit.
